      <title>Foundry Robotics Raises $100 Million Series A to Build America’s First Autonomous Factory for Assembly</title>
      <pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:00:00 UT</pubDate>
      <enclosure url="https://mms.businesswire.com/media/20261028508802/en/2949498/21/FoundryRobotics_Announcement_%281%29.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="2048"/>
      <description>EMERYVILLE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Foundry Robotics today announced its oversubscribed $100 million Series A funding round led by Marlinspike Partners. Participating in the round are early backers Khosla Ventures and Red Glass Ventures, and new investors SE Ventures, Wing VC, and Axiom Ventures, as well as existing investors Hanabi and Zero Shot Fund.Foundry builds and operates autonomous factories for complex assembly, combining AI-powered robotic cells with experienced manufacturing experts.</description>

      <title>97% of businesses have lost revenue because payment integrations were slow or complex, Payroc research finds</title>
      <pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 17:44:00 UT</pubDate>
      <enclosure url="https://mms.businesswire.com/media/20261028812094/en/2950548/21/Payroc-logo-navy-1200x938-95080af-1.png.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="2048"/>
      <description>TINLEY PARK, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Almost all software providers (97%) say slow or complex payment integrations have cost them revenue, according to new research commissioned by Payroc, a global payment-processing acquirer and technology platform. The survey of 750 senior leaders and developers at independent software vendors (ISVs) across the US, UK and Canada also found that 73% had delayed or decided against adding a payment capability because integration was too costly or complex.
